provenance_note: r4 rev 2 (plbdhw-1.3, deep review Y3-2/Y3-3/Y3-4): store energy = max over cyclic windows of the net deficit plus the part of the ONE daily design peak inside the window, the peak being the excess of the peak flow above the step mean draw (1.2 meaning; 0 in steps without draw, the full P_inst if the day has no draw) at its worst moment, accumulated in the cyclic depletion, evaluated exactly at every step and draw-event boundary (the reference simulates the periodic day with the peak at every candidate start and a running deficit at every breakpoint; the page uses prefix minimum / suffix maximum / sliding minimum); the largest excess energy of the peak is counted in the daily volume, energy and feasibility; the DVGW 3-litre rule is flagged also in one-/two-family houses. Anchor A2 re-derived by hand (excess 10.467 kW for 10 min inside the draw hour: 12.6785 kWh, 218.03 L, 300 L), 7 hand cases r4_* added (160 L in 10 min against 5 kW: 4.7491 kWh, 81.67 L, 100 L, also across a step boundary; the same with q_peak 0.2667 L/s x 10 min: excess 1.8608 kWh above the step mean, 6.6099 kWh, 113.67 L, 120 L; with t_peak 0: 100 L; peak without profile 3.1401 kWh against 0.1 kW: infeasible, minimum 0.13084 kW; 80 L store: 0.13084 kW; one-family house 500 L / 5 L pipe: small + w551_pipe_3l). Earlier: consistency with METHOD + 7 external anchors + 11 input-rule cases (plbdhw-1.2: X2-4 draw events validated with the event index, X2-5 DVGW W 551 one-/two-family house = small; expected errors and classes from the rule as written in METHOD §4, not from the page). 57 cases: expected values computed by bench-src/ref/gen_plbdhw.py, a Python implementation written from the published method (_plb/dhw/METHOD.md plbdhw-1.3, store energy as above; Ecodesign 814/2013 standing-loss limit; heat-pump/booster series share; fixed point and bisection re-derived), not from the page code; it shares the method with the page, so it checks consistency, not the method itself. 7 anchor cases (id anchor_*): expected values derived by hand arithmetic in the generator from the energy balance (EN 12831-3 cumulative demand/supply principle), the Ecodesign 814/2013 Annex II formula and the DVGW W 551 400 L / 3 L definition, independent of the model code; the generator also checks its own model against them. The hourly profile shapes are input data dumped from plb-dhw.js into ref/plbdhw_shapes.json.
